mail/pop3_reply#

POP3 replies: +OK or -ERR, and for some commands a multiline body ended by a lone dot.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let reply = ParsedPopReply(origin: bytes, mode: PopReplyMode.multiline).reply();
reply::Reply::successful;
reply::Reply::body;                  // the lines, dot-unstuffed

Description#

POP3 replies: +OK or -ERR, and for some commands a multiline body ended by a lone dot.

A negative reply never has a body. Replies are bounded: 512 bytes of status, 1 MiB per line, 16 MiB of body and 100000 lines by default.
